name: Hirano Miyuki
source:
Specialities: painting, fine arts in general
Weaknesses: indifference to the latest fads, inability to use high tech equipment well
Hobbies: painting and playing with animals

A strong-willed person with a firm sense of duty who will see any decision through to the end. At the same time, she is able to pick up on the feelings of others and considerately match how she treats the other party. She finds it very hard to deal with anything inanimate and is completely hopeless with anything mechanic to the point where even turning a computer on brings her trouble. She likes hand-crafted fashion such as reworking her and her friend's school uniforms. At present she is collecting Indian jewelry.

[Translated from [url=https://www.saibunkan.co.jp/scramble/jin/rena/miyuki.html]Scramble HOUSE's official website[/url]]
